title: Interactive Music Visualizer
content: Panoramicalis a music visualizer that creates moving images tied to a music track.Here's the trailer.But it's also a game that lets users customize various parameters of experience, resulting in something that resembles electronic lucid dreaming, or interactive hallucinogenicsynesthesia.It was created by Argentine DJ, visualist, and programmer Fernando Ramallo and Proteus co-creator David Kanaga.Via BoingBoingGurneyJourney YouTube channelMy Public FacebookpageGurneyJourney onPinterestJamesGurney Art onInstagram@GurneyJourney on Twitter
